bio:
I am a Lecturer and researcher in Computer Science and Engineering, interested in deep learning, computer vision, and applied AI for healthcare, environmental, and multimedia forensics problems.

My research spans semantic segmentation, medical image analysis, deepfake detection, and water quality prediction using machine learning. I completed my B.Sc. (2022) in CSE with a major in Artificial Intelligence from Bangladesh University of Business & Technology (BUBT), graduating with a CGPA of 3.97 (Top 1% of class). My undergraduate thesis focused on Deepfake Video Detection Using CNN and RCNN. I am currently pursuing my M.Sc. in CSE at Dhaka University of Engineering & Technology, Gazipur (DUET).
